designation: BEFORE THE INCOME TAX APPELLATE TRIBUNAL
jurisdictionNote: Income Tax Appellate Tribunal constituted under Section 252 of the Income Tax Act, 1961. Final fact-finding authority in direct tax appeals. Hears appeals against orders of CIT(A), PCIT, CIT (Exemptions), and the Assessing Officer in specified cases. Further appeal on substantial question of law lies to the jurisdictional High Court under Section 260A.

localRules: Pleadings governed by the Income Tax (Appellate Tribunal) Rules, 1963 and Section 253-255 of the Income Tax Act, 1961.
Form of appeal: Form No. 36; cross-objection: Form No. 36A. Statement of facts, grounds of appeal, and impugned order copy mandatory.
Limitation: 60 days from date of communication of the order appealed against (Section 253(3)).
Court fee: based on assessed income slab — Rs. 500 / Rs. 1,500 / Rs. 10,000 / 1% of assessed income (capped at Rs. 10,000) (Section 253(6)).
Stay application requires proof of prima facie case, balance of convenience, and financial hardship; outer limit on stay is 365 days (proviso to Section 254(2A)).
Authorised Representative: chartered accountant, advocate, or other person under Section 288 — vakalatnama / authority letter required.
Appeals from ITAT lie to the jurisdictional High Court under Section 260A on substantial question of law only.
